title: Bit by bit
hints: `x & (x - 1)` removes the lowest 1 bit of `x`: subtracting 1 turns that bit into 0 and the 0s below it into 1s. It gives both a fast bit count and the power-of-two test. For `rotate_left`, a rotation by 32 is no rotation, and shifting a 32-bit value by 32 is undefined: handle it first.
